    • createAnnotationUsage

      public static @NonNull List<AnnotationUsage> createAnnotationUsage(@NonNull Set<? extends org.jf.dexlib2.iface.Annotation> annotations, @NonNull IdentifierFactory identifierFactory)
      Converts the annotations of a dex class, field, method or parameter. System annotations ( dalvik.annotation.*, visibility SYSTEM) encode classfile attributes like Throws, Signature or InnerClass and are skipped, like the bytecode frontend does not report attributes as annotations. BUILD annotations are runtime invisible, RUNTIME ones runtime visible.

    • extractThrownExceptions

      public static @NonNull List<ClassType> extractThrownExceptions(@NonNull Set<? extends org.jf.dexlib2.iface.Annotation> annotations, @NonNull IdentifierFactory identifierFactory)
      Extracts the declared exceptions of a method from its dalvik.annotation.Throws system annotation.

    • getAnnotationDefaults

      public static @NonNull Map<String, org.jf.dexlib2.iface.value.EncodedValue> getAnnotationDefaults(@NonNull Set<? extends org.jf.dexlib2.iface.Annotation> classAnnotations)
      Returns the default values of the methods of an annotation by method name. Dex keeps them in the dalvik.annotation.AnnotationDefault system annotation of the annotation class, as an annotation of that class whose elements are the defaults.
